Remark
[Cauchy--Schwarz inequality for a symmetric nonnegative matrix] ↗ lem:cauchy-schwarz-inequality 1. appB:B.2-i-rem\group Elementary Inequalities

If $A=((a_{ij}))$ is a symmetric nonnegative $n\times n$ matrix, then for $x,y\in \R ^n$, \[ (14)\qquad \left|\sum _{i,j=1}^na_{ij}x_iy_j\right| \leq \left(\sum _{i,j=1}^na_{ij}x_ix_j\right)^{1/2} \left(\sum _{i,j=1}^na_{ij}y_iy_j\right)^{1/2}. \]
